clearMemory.description: This permanently drops every shared-memory entry for this team.
clearMemory.title: Clear shared memory?

forceResolve.description: This resolves the poll with the lead's override, ignoring outstanding votes.
forceResolve.title: Force-resolve consensus?

onCritical.description: Selecting "pause for review" or "hand off to background" changes how the runtime blocks at the critical budget threshold.
onCritical.title: Change critical action?

removeTeammate.description: This removes the teammate from the team. Tasks they claimed will be released.
removeTeammate.title: Remove teammate?

deleteWarning: This permanently removes the team, all members, tasks, and messages.

execution.description: Team-level execution defaults (ADR-0090): the binding every inheriting teammate resolves to, and the team-to-team delegation depth cap.
execution.maxDelegationDepthHint: Team-to-team delegations only (default 2). A team at the cap has its further delegations refused. Distinct from native subagent nesting depth.
execution.title: Execution

adaptiveReplan.description: Between waves of a run, the lead reviews results and can inject, cancel, reorder, or finish the remaining tasks.
adaptiveReplan.heading: Adaptive re-planning
adaptiveReplan.requireApproval: Require approval before applying a re-plan

approval.heading: Approvals
approval.requireDelegationApproval: Require approval before delegating to an external agent
approval.requirePlanApproval: Require plan approval before run starts
approval.requireResultReviewHint: Successful auto-runs land in the Review column for human acceptance; the run itself keeps progressing.
approval.taskReviewHint: The lead reviews every task's work — and the diff it produced — before dependent tasks may start. Work the lead rejects goes back to the same teammate to revise. A task that cannot be approved fails the run.

governance.description: Approval gates, budget thresholds, escalation behavior, and refusal detection.

escalation.allowOperatorPatternOverride: Allow operator to override the execution pattern
escalation.heading: Escalation
escalation.pauseOnHighRisk: Pause automatically when the routing assessment flags high risk

nudges.busySignalHint: Skipped if the member produced tool activity inside this window — it is working, not stuck.
nudges.description: When a teammate turn fails on a provider rate limit, the runtime waits out the cooldown and sends one "continue" nudge instead of aborting the whole wave.
nudges.heading: Rate-limit nudges
nudges.maxPerMemberPerHour: Max nudges per member per hour

progressLedger.allowAutonomousConsensus: Allow autonomously opening a consensus on stall
progressLedger.allowAutonomousDelegation: Allow autonomously delegating work on stall
progressLedger.description: After a wave stalls (no new completed tasks or output), a judge diagnoses the run and can re-plan, open a consensus, or delegate to break the stall.
progressLedger.heading: Autonomous progress ledger

refusal.detect: Detect refusal patterns in teammate output
refusal.heading: Refusal detection
refusal.patternsPlaceholder:
I cannot help with that
I'm not able to

governance.title: Governance policy

knowledgeTwins.empty: No digital employees yet. Create one in the Twin workbench.
knowledgeTwins.hint: Twins selected here can be searched by any teammate via the knowledge tool during a run.
knowledgeTwins.title: Digital employee knowledge

acl.aclHint: Empty "readable by" means every teammate can read this entry.

composer.piiBlocked: Write blocked: the value contains PII.
composer.tagsPlaceholder: Add a tag and press Enter

memory.description: Key/value entries written by teammates during a run. Writes are PII-gated.

filter.empty: No entries match the current filters.

memory.title: Shared memory

name: Team name

plugins.intro: These plugin capabilities are inherited by every teammate. Use per-teammate overlays to override them on a specific member.

prFeedback.caveat: Runs while the team run is active and for a short window after; needs a GitHub remote and resolvable credentials (e.g. gh auth).
prFeedback.description: Observe each teammate's pull request (CI, review comments, merge conflicts) and route the feedback back to the team as a guarded nudge. Off by default; desktop app + a GitHub repository with credentials only.

observeWindow.hint: How long to keep polling each PR after the task list finishes. One pass captures the current state; a window keeps monitoring CI/reviews (and extends the run).
observeWindow.label: Keep observing after the run

publishPr.hint: Push each teammate's branch and open a pull request automatically. Off = only observe PRs teammates open themselves.
publishPr.label: Auto-open a PR per teammate

reviewer.hint: Run an automated reviewer over each PR's diff and route a changes-requested verdict back to the teammate.
reviewer.label: Internal reviewer agent

prFeedback.title: PR feedback loop

stackedDelivery.caveat: Desktop app only, and only for a GitHub remote whose default branch can be resolved. A run that cannot be stacked is published as it is today.
stackedDelivery.description: When a completed run produced several branches in one repository, open them as a chain of pull requests instead of a flat set — each based on the one below it, so every review shows only its own change.

enabled.hint: Off by default. Turning it on changes how a finished run reaches GitHub.
enabled.label: Stack this team's pull requests

minLayers.hint: Runs with fewer branches than the minimum are published flat. Extra branches beyond the maximum are left out of the stack rather than dropped.
minLayers.label: Fewest layers

stackedDelivery.title: Stacked delivery

title: Team Settings

hint.always: Orchestrate every run for this team.
hint.auto: Orchestrate only when routing judges the task complex.
hint.never: Never auto-orchestrate; use Run with ultracode manually.

ultracode.description: Run the multi-agent quality patterns (sweep, loop-until-dry, adversarial verify, judge panel, completeness critic, synthesize) instead of a flat task list. Tool-enabled teammates run on the desktop sidecar; the web/mobile shells fall back to text-only reasoning.
ultracode.title: Ultracode orchestration

workingDir.hint: Repo path tool-enabled teammates read and run commands in (desktop only).
workingDir.label: Working directory

worktrees.caveat: Worktrees branch off the working directory's current commit (HEAD), so uncommitted changes there are not visible to agents.
worktrees.description: Give each teammate dispatch its own git worktree + branch so parallel agents never overwrite each other's work or git state. Off by default; desktop app + git repository only.

hint.manual: Leave every branch for you to review and merge.
hint.merge-all: Merge all successful branches into one integration branch; a conflict stops and reports (never your real branch).
hint.select: Keep one branch and discard the rest.

worktrees.title: Worktree isolation
